motivation: v0.32 established selector non-learning and utility non-discrimination in the v0.31 utility pathway.
v0.32 could not identify the upstream cause because decisive counterfactual-supervision and optimization diagnostics were not recorded.
v0.33 will redesign the utility-supervision and selector-learning pathway only after prospectively freezing observability, learning-signal, and pre-training verification requirements.
non_objectives: no reopening or modification of v0.31 or v0.32
no post-hoc reconstruction of missing v0.31 diagnostics
no formal performance claim at Step0 or Step1
primary_objective: Create a utility-learning pathway whose supervision signal, target transform, selector optimization, and intervention activation are directly observable and verifiable before formal training.
scientific_principles: preserve stable-reference behavior unless prospectively authorized
title: Prospective Utility-Supervision and Selector-Learning Redesign
